body:
Appeal for a Perma-Ban (Runar_ 'Forcefield')

Hi I wanted to appeal my ban, I've never installed any kind of hacks clients so I wanted to see an evidence of my hacking, if possible of course. I'm quite experienced on pvp (almost 2 years playing Overcast Network and Kohi) and I have a pretty good ping on this server (about 80 ms), so it might be a confusion.

I don't really have any proof showing that I am legit, but I can link my profiles of the two servers where I tend to play (https://oc.tc/Runar_ and http://kohi.net/u/Runar_/#practice ) where i never had an infraction of hacking and I have a lot of days played and good stats.

I know that the links are not proving that I wasn't hacking, but since I can't record due to my bad fps, is the only way I see to proof that I am just an over the average pvper (not pretending to sound cocky or anything).

I don't know if I used correctly the appeal system, so please if someone could tell how to do it properly, i'll appreciate that. Also I am spanish so please forgive me for my possible grammar/expression mistakes. As I said I've never used hacks.
